candidates: In test files, template-literal diagram strings should not include a trailing newline before the closing backtick. The backtick should appear immediately after the last content line (e.g., `}\`;` not `}\n\``), and new tests should match the formatting convention already established in the same test file.
TypeScript `interface` declarations should end with a trailing semicolon after the closing brace (`};`), for consistency with `type` alias declarations in the same file (e.g., in `classTypes.ts`).

When adding or modifying a function that already has JSDoc, ensure every parameter — including optional ones — has a corresponding `@param` tag with a name and brief description. Do not leave the JSDoc out of sync with the function signature after a refactor.
